lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's ten? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 10? Nope!

lines.text: A pond has two hundred fish, and ninety percent are goldfish.
lines.caption: A pond has 200 fish, and 90% are goldfish.

lines.text: How many goldfish must go, so that eighty percent of the fish left are goldfish?
lines.caption: How many goldfish must go, so that 80% of the fish left are goldfish?

lines.text: Watch the fish that stay! One hundred eighty goldfish means twenty other fish.
lines.caption: Watch the fish that stay! 180 goldfish means 20 other fish.

lines.text: Those twenty never leave. At the end, they're twenty percent: one fifth of the pond.
lines.caption: Those 20 never leave. At the end, they're 20%: 1/5 of the pond.

lines.text: So the pond ends with five times twenty, one hundred fish.
lines.caption: So the pond ends with 5 × 20, 100 fish.

lines.text: Two hundred down to one hundred. So one hundred goldfish must go!
lines.caption: 200 down to 100. So 100 goldfish must go!

lines.text: Did you get one hundred goldfish? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 100 goldfish? Tell me below!
